messages:
maya_ops: Heads up — found several DB snapshot objects without CMEK headers from last night's backup. spot-check via head-object returned empty ServerSideEncryption.
liam_sec: Which bucket/keys?
maya_ops: s3://backups/prod/db/2026-11-12/snap-20261112-03.tar.gz
trent_sre: Likely grant expiry; long backups sometimes outlive short-lived KMS grants.
encops-bot: [audit-search] service:backup-uploader time>=2026-11-12T01:00:00Z returned 198 events.
priya_db: The uploader service has a preflight that checks KMS access but it only runs at start; multipart uploads can span hours.
liam_sec: Confirm grant history please — was a short TTL issued?
encops-bot: grant-log: G-20261112-09, principal: backup-uploader, kms-key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/zzzz, issued=2026-11-12T02:00:00Z, ttl=1h, expired=2026-11-12T03:00:00Z
maya_ops: Backup run 02:30-04:15, so overlap exists.
trent_sre: Behavior: uploader falls back to SSE-S3 on AccessDenied. There's an older multipart commit bug where final head-object metadata is not set when parts were uploaded pre-expiry and commit occurs post-expiry.
liam_sec: That explains empty SSE header. Action: 1) enumerate objects created 02:30-04:15. 2) Flag objects with missing SSE headers as compliance findings. 3) Re-encrypt by copy-object to CMEK where possible. 4) Update grant issuance TTL to cover longest job + buffer. 5) Change uploader to fail on missing CMEK instead of silent fallback.
priya_db: I'll run a scan for last 60 days to find similar gaps and produce list.csv.
trent_sre: I'll add a preflight KMS-grant check and post-upload head-object verify. Also open infra ticket to make copier role have kms:Encrypt permissions.
liam_sec: Create incident ENC-2026-117, severity=medium, owners=[maya_ops,trent_sre,priya_db]. Notify compliance.
maya_ops: Starting copy-reencrypt for a small batch to validate process. will update.
encops-bot: [scan-result] affected=6 sample=["snap-20261112-03.tar.gz","snap-20261112-07.tar.gz"]
maya_ops: 2/6 re-encrypted, 4 failed due to AccessDenied from kms:Encrypt on copier role. tagging infra-automation.
liam_sec: Good catch. Post-incident: require head-object encryption assertion in CI jobs and alert when head-object has no SSE metadata for backup prefixes.
priya_db: Uploading list.csv to #eng-security-private.
